tools.name: evaluate_trade
tools.description:
Pre-trade risk check for a proposed trade. Call this BEFORE executing
any trade and treat a "deny" decision as a hard stop.

Evaluated at a fixed Tier 1 ceiling ($5,000 notional). For higher
limits, use `evaluate_trade_paid` (Tier 2, $25,000) which settles an
x402 payment on-chain.

tools.name: evaluate_trade_paid
tools.description:
Pre-trade risk check gated by an x402 payment. Evaluated as COLR

No COLR holdings are required — the on-chain payment is the

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "evaluate_trade_paid" is 644 chars, far longer than this server's median (120). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Pre-trade risk check gated by an x402 payment. Evaluated as COLR Tier 2: $25,000 notional ceiling, 10/25 per-minute rate limits. No COLR holdings are required —…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "evaluate_trade" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

not get COLR tier gating. For higher tiers, use the REST API with

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
